body:
Fixes #2320. Fixes #2312, #2313, #2314, #2315, #2316, #2317, #2318, #2319.

On 2026-09-27, `solve <issue> --model formal-ai --tool <claude|agent|codex> --attach-logs --verbose --no-tool-check --disable-report-issue --language en` was run on three Hello World tasks. All three PRs ended in draft:

- **Kotlin (claude)** got a committed `Main.jar`, a stale body and `🛑 Automation stopped`.
- **Scala (agent)** ended with no change.
- **Rust (codex)** stopped after 78 identical tool calls.

Each chain started in a Formal AI-specific path. This PR fixes each defect and removes those paths instead of adding new ones. Every model now goes through the same prompt, restart, draft, breaker, failure-classification and PR-body code.

The case study is in [`docs/case-studies/issue-2320/`](docs/case-studies/issue-2320/README.md): the timeline, the per-run evidence with `log:line` references in `evidence.md`, and the raw logs.

## Reproduction

Every test below replays the 2026-09-27 evidence (log excerpts, PR state, comments). Each one fails on `main` and passes here. Two experiments replay whole runs:

- `node experiments/replay-rust-codex-2316.mjs` feeds the Rust session's codex stream into the new breaker. It stops at call 6, not 78:
  `🛑 Repeated-tool-call breaker (repeated_tool_call): Identical tool call repeated 6 times in a row …`
- `node experiments/critical-error-recovery-branch-2315.mjs` reproduces the Kotlin critical-error recovery on a scratch repo. `Main.kt` and `notes.md` are pushed to `recovery/issue-1`, `Main.jar` and `target/` are skipped, and the PR branch, index and worktree are unchanged.

## What changed

| Sub-issue | Fix | Test |
| --- | --- | --- |
| #2312 deliberate draft ≠ draft self-heal | A draft the session left on purpose (empty diff) restarts the AI with the verdict as feedback, instead of 3 fake "Draft restored" and `draft_pull_request`. A failed session no longer ends the watch loop. Deliberate drafts are restored to their pre-run state at the end. | `tests/deliberate-draft-restarts-ai-2312.test.mjs` |
| #2313 byte-identical restarts | The Formal AI prompt dialect and the empty system prompt are gone; all models get the same prompts. One `buildUncommittedChangesFeedback` names the exact `git status --porcelain` entries with commit/ignore/delete instructions. `no_progress_between_sessions` requires a changed input. "nothing to commit" is benign. | `tests/restart-prompt-names-uncommitted-files-2313.test.mjs` |
| #2314 `--tool agent` loses gh auth | `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` is no longer relocated. Agent and OpenCode get `LINK_ASSISTANT_AGENT_CONFIG_DIR` / `OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR`. `GH_CONFIG_DIR` and `GH_TOKEN` reach the tool env. `gh auth status` is preflighted with that env, and the run fails fast with the cause attached. | `tests/formal-ai-tool-env-keeps-gh-auth-2314.test.mjs` |
| #2315 critical-error commit pollutes the PR | Recovery snapshots through a private index onto `recovery/<branch>`. The PR branch, index and worktree are untouched, binaries and build directories are never preserved, and the comment names the branch. | `tests/critical-error-recovery-keeps-pr-branch-clean-2315.test.mjs` |
| #2316 breaker only for claude | `tool-call-loop-guard.lib.mjs` normalises codex, agent, opencode, gemini and qwen streams into the shared breaker. It also trips on identical successful calls. A cumulative input total is shown as a total, not as `6.2M / 200K (3092%)`. | `tests/repeated-tool-call-all-tools-2316.test.mjs` |
| #2317 attribution guard misreads registry logs | Identity is read only from generation records (`step_start` / `step_finish`, assistant message info), not from provider-registry `found` logs. | `tests/formal-ai-attribution-generation-identity-2317.test.mjs` |
| #2318 stale body, double cost, quoted title | The Changes section is solve-owned (`hive-mind:changes` markers), lists the paths, and is regenerated from the diff after every session for every model. Free models print one cost. Title quoting is pinned by a test. | `tests/pr-body-changes-regeneration-2318.test.mjs` |
| #2319 one path for every model + e2e | `classifyFormalAiToolResult` and the Formal AI Playwright MCP skip are removed. `isFormalAiModel` is down from 21 to 13 src files. Every remaining use is listed and justified in `docs/MODEL-SPECIFIC-BEHAVIOURS.md` (+ ru/zh/hi). A manual Hello World end-to-end matrix is added. | `tests/e2e-hello-world-matrix-2319.test.mjs` |

## Hello World end-to-end matrix

`.github/workflows/e2e-hello-world-matrix.yml` runs on `workflow_dispatch` only, because every row creates a repository and spends a session. It needs the `E2E_GITHUB_TOKEN` secret. Rows: `formal-ai` × claude/agent/codex, plus `nemotron-3-super-free` on agent as the LLM control. Each row runs the #2320 command unchanged, then asserts:

- the PR is ready for review;
- the diff is the program, one workflow and at most one test script, with no placeholders or build artefacts;
- the workflow log prints exactly `Hello, World!`;
- the checks are green;
- the body's Changes section lists every file;
- the title is final;
- there is no `🛑 Automation stopped` comment.

Local run: `node scripts/e2e-hello-world.mjs --tool agent --model formal-ai [--issue <url>] [--dry-run]`. The assertions are unit-tested against the 2026-09-27 Kotlin PR, which fails exactly 5 of them, and against a clean answer, which passes all of them.

The matrix has not been dispatched from this PR. It needs the secret and creates external repositories, so it is left to a maintainer.

## Not done here

The stray `Main.java` / `Main.class` / `Main.jar` commits on the `konard/test-hello-world-*` branches from the 2026-09-27 runs are still there. Removing them changes external repositories, so it is left to the operator (`cleanup-test-repos.yml` or a rerun).

## Checks

`npm run lint`, `format:check`, `check:duplication` and `check:secrets` pass. The full default suite (512 files) was run locally. It found three files that still asserted the pre-#2315/#2316 behaviour; they were updated in d00b3a22 and pass on rerun. `detect-changes` had failed on a newly published `@dotenvx/dotenvx` 2.31.1 (dependency freshness), so the pin is bumped.
title: One code path for every model: fix the 2026-09-27 formal-ai Hello World failures (#2312–#2319)
